name: Talkdesk
tagline: Talkdesk is a cloud contact centre platform with AI capabilities including virtual agents, real-time agent assistance, quality management AI, and workforce management optimisation. Its Talkdesk AI Trainer lets contact centres fine-tune NLP models for their specific industry vocabulary without machine learning expertise.
